stages.headline: How many roots does x³ − 3x + 3 = 0 have?
stages.headlineEnglish: How many roots does x³ − 3x + 3 = 0 have?
stages.problemText: How many roots does x³ − 3x + 3 = 0 have?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. Both extremal values are positive: one root.
